construction.name: cross_base_forced_phase_inclusion
construction.proof:
Forced cyclic-incidence phase for concentric cross-base inclusion

Let canonical regular p- and q-gons have their first vertices on +x, circumradii Rp,Rq, and source apothem ap=Rp*cos(pi/p). Their directed source facet normals have arguments pi/p+2*pi*i/p; target vertices after one fixed rotation theta have arguments theta+2*pi*j/q. The complete difference set is pi/p-theta+(2*pi/L)Z modulo2pi, L=lcm(p,q). This follows from Bezout for the subgroup generated by1/p and1/q. Thus the largest support dot product over ALL source facet/target vertex pairs is Rq*cos(d), where d is distance of pi/p-theta to (2*pi/L)Z and lies in[0,pi/L]. Centering this grid gives theta=pi/p+pi/L modulo2pi/L, and base dilation alpha0=(Rq/ap)*cos(pi/L). This is one derived incidence phase, not an angle sweep.

For the even base sizes6,8,12, the nonidentity directed pairs are6->8 and12->8 at theta=pi/24, and6->12 at theta=pi/12. The reverse directed pairs8->6,8->12,12->6 already attain the centered phase at identity; retain them as neutral source controls and do not duplicate their metric screen. Same-base pairs are excluded.

For source prism height h and target height H, use alpha>=max(alpha0,H/h). Every whole target Q*T is then inside alpha*P, with common canonical Q=Rz(theta) and zero offset. Source owner c_i+R_i P gives target alpha*c_i+R_i Q T. The source centers scale together; each target frame is the exact composition of its original native frame with the SAME derived Q. All inherited source pair separators apply simultaneously.

Native realization uses a rational quaternion Qr obtained by a single declared rounding of the analytically derived half-angle. Its exact rational rotation is retained, and all actual canonical target vertices are checked against all raw P.N/P.B facets at an outward rational alpha. Hence correctness does not rely on identifying rounded Qr with the ideal algebraic Q. Quaternion products are represented homogeneously by exact integers, so inherited R_i is not independently rounded. Actual final vertices, inherited pair planes, shared recentering, rational restoration and binary64 center errors are checked separately. Preserve the ideal formula, rounded rotation and all source authors/frames.

contribution.method:
This batch contains 23 fresh campaign cases, distinct from all 54 earlier fresh archives: 19 antiprism cases, three prism cases and one pentakis-dodecahedron self-packing. Sixteen improve the pinned current nominal/reference bound; seven improve complete native certificates without claiming a new ideal nominal value.

The main new construction places fixed-phase antiprism rings and whole axial slots inside actual complete regular-prism parents. The forced phase comes from the full cyclic difference grid. Every child, sibling slab and inherited parent separator is retained. Literal whole-owner prefixes give additional complete cases. For six hexagonal antiprisms in a cube, one common center contraction releases the artificial parent facets while all 15 target-pair separators remain simultaneously valid; the certified side is 2.862714781480716. No angle sweep is used.

A reciprocal golden-host inclusion and common return give eleven pentakis dodecahedra in their own host at 2.82404531854329. The three prism cases retain complete source-column and height/collar operations from the reviewed bank.

All active witnesses passed independent source, full geometry and current-public/private comparisons, followed by both official checks on the packaged native files. The archive preserves complete parent packings, physical decoders, common-return certificates and original source attribution. Some provenance audit scripts require the authenticated upstream Git snapshot or reviewed-source registry; the bundled official native validators are directly replayable.

Credit the new finite constructions exactly to PingYou Ltd. Original donors and their authors remain explicitly credited. These contributions may be published under the repository’s MIT license. No global optimality is claimed. Fresh campaign cases, live site credit and submission acceptance are tracked separately.
